headline: Financial Trio's Profits Surpass NT$1 Trillion in First 7 Months; Full-Year Record High Expected | Industry
summary: Taiwan's banking, insurance and securities sectors earned a cumulative NT$1.00118 trillion in the first seven months, up 105.8% year on year. Full-year 2024's record of NT$1.0588 trillion is expected to be surpassed.
why: Taiwan's large financial groups are key lenders and asset managers, and their earnings reflect the strength of the island's capital markets and rate environment.
